name: EMA crossover (reference migration)
description: Trend following: hold long while fast EMA is above slow EMA, short while below. Deterministic DSL migration of strategies.ema_crossover (registry default parameters).

hypothesis.statement: Captures medium-term directional drift when fast/slow EMA alignment persists.
hypothesis.risk_assumptions: ATR stop absorbs noise of the traded timeframe.

risk.note: Stops constrain trade geometry only; position risk is authorized solely by the Aegis Risk Engine.

metadata.explanation: State mode: position persists while alignment holds; opposite alignment flips it.
